name: Red Cloud Mesa
summary: Red Cloud Mesa is an elevated plateau in southern Mulgore, serving as the training ground and ancestral starting point for young tauren braves. Once a peaceful expanse of rolling grassland, the mesa is currently besieged by aggressive Bristleback quilboar pushing out from Brambleblade Ravine. Camp Narache remains the last secure bastion of tauren authority on the plateau.

sections.title: A Sacred Mesa Under Siege
sections.body: Perched high above the rest of Mulgore, Red Cloud Mesa long stood as a peaceful haven where young tauren learned the ways of the Earth Mother, hunting, and tribal defense. That pastoral peace shattered when the Bristleback tribe erupted from Brambleblade Ravine in the northeast. Armed with aggressive thorn magic, the quilboar have choked the surrounding hillsides in razor-sharp brambles, torched tribal tents, and corrupted the local water supply. Only Camp Narache holds out, relying on novice defenders to halt the swarm before the plateau falls entirely.

sections.title: Severed Roads and Ancient Watchposts
sections.body: The quilboar onslaught has drastically reshaped the mesa's geography. A massive landslide wiped out the original southern pass, which was promptly fortified by the quilboar chieftain into Thornmantle's Hideout. To maintain any link to the valleys below, the tauren carved a steep new northern trail leading straight down toward the plains of Mulgore. Meanwhile, ancestral trails wind upward to vantage points like Fargaze Mesa, allowing tribal scouts to survey the ongoing struggle for their homeland.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Red Cloud Mesa?
faq.answer: Red Cloud Mesa serves as the testing ground for young tauren coming of age. Here, youths prove their worth as hunters, shamans, druids, and warriors by serving their elders and defending their people before descending into the wider valleys of Mulgore.

faq.q: Why are there quilboar attacking the mesa?
faq.answer: The Bristleback quilboar have expanded aggressively out of Brambleblade Ravine in search of territory and resources. Driven by their aggressive chieftains, they spread sharp thorns over the soil, burned down settlements, and poisoned tribal water wells to push the tauren off the high ground.

faq.q: How do you leave Red Cloud Mesa?
aliases: how to get down from red cloud mesa
faq.answer: The old southern exit was ruined by a rockslide and conquered by the quilboar. To connect with the rest of Mulgore, the tauren excavated a new northern trail that snakes down the cliffs from just north of Camp Narache into the lower plains.

aliases: tauren base on red cloud mesa
faq.answer: Camp Narache is maintained by tauren tribal elders, trainers, and chieftains. It serves as the central settlement on the mesa and the final safe stronghold where new braves gather strength, receive wisdom, and launch counterstrikes against the Bristlebacks.

Thornmantle's Hideout is a heavily fortified lair established in the rubble of the collapsed southwest pass. It is held by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, the leader orchestrating the Bristleback quilboar assault across the mesa.

angles.text: For every young tauren, Red Cloud Mesa is where childhood ends and life as a defender of the tribes begins. Its soil is sacred ground where you earn your horns under the gaze of the Earth Mother.
The stability of Mulgore is critical to the young Horde's foothold on southern Kalimdor, making the defense of this high mesa essential to preserving tauren heritage and safety.
